nodes.name: defaults.go
nodes.summary: Registers API defaulting functions for cert-manager Certificate and CertificateRequest types, including the runtime default for the private key rotation policy.

nodes.name: doc.go
nodes.summary: Package documentation and code-generation markers that drive conversion and defaulting generation between the internal and external cert-manager v1 API types.

nodes.name: register.go
nodes.summary: Registers the internal cert-manager v1 API group and scheme builder and exposes the resource helper used for conversions and serialization.

nodes.name: zz_generated.defaults.go
nodes.summary: Generated defaulting registration that wires the cert-manager v1 API types into a Kubernetes runtime scheme.
nodes.languageNotes: Generated by k8s.io/code-generator defaulter-gen; edits are overwritten on regeneration.

nodes.name: certificate.go
nodes.summary: Implements admission validation for Certificate resources, checking issuer references, SANs, key usages, durations, keystores, and secret templates.

nodes.name: certificaterequest.go
nodes.summary: Validates CertificateRequest resources and their approval conditions, including CSR spec consistency and condition transition rules.

nodes.name: SetRuntimeDefaults_Certificate
nodes.summary: Applies runtime defaults to a Certificate, setting the private key rotation policy according to the feature gate.

nodes.name: SetObjectDefaults_Certificate
nodes.summary: Sets defaults on a single Certificate object during scheme defaulting.

nodes.name: SetObjectDefaults_CertificateList
nodes.summary: Applies Certificate defaults to every item in a CertificateList.

nodes.name: SetObjectDefaults_CertificateRequest
nodes.summary: Sets defaults on a single CertificateRequest object during scheme defaulting.

nodes.name: SetObjectDefaults_CertificateRequestList
nodes.summary: Applies CertificateRequest defaults to every item in a CertificateRequestList.

nodes.name: Resource
nodes.summary: Returns the GroupResource identifying cert-manager v1 resources in the internal API group.

nodes.name: RegisterDefaults
nodes.summary: Registers all generated defaulting functions for cert-manager v1 types with the given scheme.

nodes.name: ValidateCertificateSpec
nodes.summary: Validates the full Certificate spec including secret name, issuer reference, SANs, key usages, duration, keystores, and secret templates.

nodes.name: ValidateCertificate
nodes.summary: Admission entry point that validates a Certificate on create.

nodes.name: ValidateUpdateCertificate
nodes.summary: Admission entry point that validates a Certificate on update.

nodes.name: validateIssuerRef
nodes.summary: Validates that an issuer reference uses an allowed kind, group, and non-empty name.

nodes.name: validateIPAddresses
nodes.summary: Validates that every IP SAN parses as a valid IP address.

nodes.name: validateEmailAddresses
nodes.summary: Validates that every email SAN parses as a valid RFC 5322 mailbox.

nodes.name: validateUsages
nodes.summary: Validates that requested key usages are non-empty and only contain known values.

nodes.name: validateSecretTemplateAnnotations
nodes.summary: Rejects reserved cert-manager annotation keys in a Certificate secret template.

nodes.name: ValidateDuration
nodes.summary: Validates the requested certificate duration against the issuer maximum and the renewal window.

nodes.name: validateAdditionalOutputFormats
nodes.summary: Validates additional output formats, rejecting unsupported or duplicate entries.

nodes.name: validateKeystores
nodes.summary: Validates JKS and PKCS#12 keystore configuration including password secret references.

nodes.name: ValidateCertificateRequest
nodes.summary: Admission entry point that validates a CertificateRequest on create.

nodes.name: ValidateUpdateCertificateRequest
nodes.summary: Validates immutable CertificateRequest fields across an update, allowing only approval conditions to change.

nodes.name: validateCertificateRequestAnnotations
nodes.summary: Rejects CertificateRequest annotations that would change immutable request metadata.

nodes.name: ValidateCertificateRequestSpec
nodes.summary: Validates a CertificateRequest spec, including its CSR and issuer reference.

nodes.name: validateCertificateRequestSpecRequest
nodes.summary: Validates the encoded CSR and issuer reference contained in a CertificateRequest spec.

nodes.name: ValidateCertificateRequestApprovalCondition
nodes.summary: Validates approval conditions, ensuring approved and denied states are mutually exclusive.

nodes.name: ValidateUpdateCertificateRequestApprovalCondition
nodes.summary: Validates transitions of approval conditions on an existing CertificateRequest.
